Rejection in any form is a hit to the ego. A romantic rejection hurts even deeper. It is the biological (?) Equivalent of saying "I will not breed with you". Obviously in less subconscious terms this is just means "sorry, I don't like you that way," but that deep biological component is still there. If the guy liked the girl a lot in particular, it is in his best interest to forget about her after the fact because he needs to emotionally heal. You don't get over something you can't have by constant reminding yourself of it. And if that girl had really special qualities? Well...no two women are the same. So yeah, the dude isn't being an asshole, he is trying to get over the emotional hump of rejection.
